quests.instruction: Kai eats breakfast before leaving for school. Ruby is walking home from school with her backpack. Who is in the afternoon part of the day?
quests.hint: Someone has finished school. Someone else is just starting.
quests.explanation: Going home after school happens in the afternoon. Kai's breakfast before leaving belongs to the morning.
quests.funFact: In the afternoon, many people feel a little sleepy, so some countries have a short rest time at midday.

quests.instruction: Which meal is usually eaten in the middle of the day?
quests.hint: It sits between the first meal and the last meal.
quests.explanation: Lunch comes around the middle of the day, after the morning and before the late afternoon.
quests.funFact: Many schools around the world serve lunch to students at a set time each day.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day comes right after the morning?
quests.hint: Count the parts in order: morning, then what?
quests.explanation: The day goes morning, afternoon, evening, then night. The afternoon follows the morning.
quests.funFact: Noon is the moment halfway through the day, and afternoon begins right after it.

quests.instruction: The windows glow orange while Dad stirs a big pot of soup. The Sun is sinking close to the rooftops. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Where is the Sun when it is close to the rooftops?
quests.explanation: A low Sun that colors the windows is a sign the day is winding down, so it is the evening.
quests.funFact: Soup is a good dinner for cool evenings because it is warm and filling.

quests.instruction: Nora's last class has just finished and the Sun is still high and bright. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: The Sun has not started sinking yet.
quests.explanation: The Sun is still high after school ends, so it is afternoon. Evening comes later, when the Sun is low.
quests.funFact: In many places, school ends in the afternoon, while it is still bright outside.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day usually comes just before bedtime?
quests.hint: Bedtime follows dinner, and dinner is not in the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: Evening comes right before night. It is when many families eat dinner and relax before going to sleep.
quests.funFact: Many people call the early part of the night the evening, when the day is ending.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day has a dark sky and quiet streets?
quests.hint: Decide when most people are inside and resting.
quests.explanation: Night is when our part of Earth faces away from the Sun, so the sky is dark and most places are quiet.
quests.funFact: Some cities stay busy at night, but most people still sleep during these hours.

quests.instruction: Breakfast, lunch, or dinner: which meal is usually eaten latest in the day?
quests.hint: Picture the order of meals from the start of the day.
quests.explanation: Dinner is the last big meal of the day, so it usually happens in the evening.
quests.funFact: Some people also eat a small snack after dinner, but dinner is still the last main meal.

quests.instruction: A toddler yawns and rubs her eyes at dinner while the sky outside is darkening. What comes next for her?
quests.hint: Yawns and a darkening sky are telling you something about the end of the day.
quests.explanation: Tired eyes and a darkening sky mean that bedtime is not far away.
quests.funFact: Yawning is common when we feel tired, and it can even spread from person to person.

quests.instruction: Sam just rolled out of bed. Pia just got home from school. Who is about to eat the first meal of their day?
quests.hint: Consider who has been awake longer today.
quests.explanation: Breakfast is the first meal of the day. Sam just woke up, so he is the one about to have it.
quests.funFact: The word breakfast means ending the fast of the night, which is the time you went without eating.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day is just starting when the Sun first appears over the horizon?
quests.hint: The Sun is coming back, not leaving.
quests.explanation: When the Sun first appears, a new day begins and we call that part of the day the morning.
quests.funFact: Sunrise happens in the east, where the Sun first appears in the sky.

quests.instruction: Which of these fits the afternoon best?
quests.hint: Look for the activity that needs you awake and full of energy in the bright part of the day.
quests.explanation: After school, the Sun is still up, so afternoon is a good time to play soccer and run around.
quests.funFact: Playing sports helps your heart and muscles stay strong.

quests.instruction: A child wakes to the alarm clock and smells pancakes sizzling in the kitchen. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Notice the meal that starts the day.
quests.explanation: Waking to an alarm and smelling pancakes is typical of a morning at home.
quests.funFact: Pancakes can be made with just flour, milk, eggs, and a little oil.

quests.instruction: A child hears "Time for bed!" and crawls under the covers while stars twinkle outside. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Stars come out when the sky is dark.
quests.explanation: Bedtime and stars both belong to night, when the sky is dark and it is time to rest.
quests.funFact: Stars twinkle because their light bends as it passes through moving air.

quests.instruction: Which of these might you do in the evening?
quests.hint: Dinner has a time of day that is not morning.
quests.explanation: Dinner is usually eaten in the evening, when the day is winding down.
quests.funFact: Candles were once the main way people lit their homes on dark evenings.

quests.instruction: Hannah says the school day is almost over and she is going home. Zeke says his school day has only just begun. Who is describing the afternoon?
quests.hint: Remember whose school day is further along.
quests.explanation: Hannah's day is almost over, so it is the afternoon. Zeke's day is just starting, so it is morning.
quests.funFact: In some places, there are schools with morning shifts and afternoon shifts.

quests.instruction: The house is silent, a clock ticks softly, and everyone is fast asleep. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Look at what everyone in the house is doing.
quests.explanation: When a whole house is asleep and silent, it is night, the part of the day set aside for rest.
quests.funFact: Many people sleep deepest in the middle of the night.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a sign that the day is ending?
quests.correctAnswer: The Sun sinking toward the horizon
options: The Sun sinking toward the horizon
quests.hint: One of these is about starting the day, and the other is about finishing it.
quests.explanation: When the Sun sinks low, daylight is fading. A rooster crowing at dawn is a sign that a day is starting.
quests.funFact: The Sun does not really move. It looks like it does because Earth spins.

quests.instruction: Which time comes first in a day: breakfast time or dinner time?
quests.hint: One of these is near sunrise. The other is near sunset.
quests.explanation: Breakfast comes in the morning at the start of the day. Dinner comes in the evening near the end of the day.
quests.funFact: Some people also have a snack between meals, and it is called a snack.

quests.instruction: Ali plays tag with friends after lunch, and the Sun is high. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Notice that the Sun is high and it is after lunch.
quests.explanation: After lunch and with the Sun still high, it is afternoon, a time of bright light and busy play.
quests.funFact: Playing games like tag can help children practice running and dodging.

quests.instruction: A sleepy girl yawns and wishes she could go back to bed, but the Sun is just coming up. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: She wishes for bed, but notice what the Sun is doing.
quests.explanation: A rising Sun means the morning has begun, even if someone feels sleepy and wants to rest a little longer.
quests.funFact: Feeling groggy after waking up is common, and a bit of light and movement can help you wake up.

quests.instruction: Which meal is eaten while the sky is bright?
quests.hint: Ask yourself what the word midnight means.
quests.explanation: Lunch is a daylight meal. A midnight snack happens in the dark middle of the night.
quests.funFact: A twelve-hour clock face goes around twice in one day.

quests.instruction: As evening turns into night, the sky gets...
quests.hint: Is the Sun getting closer to the horizon or farther from it?
quests.explanation: After sunset, light fades from the sky, so evening slowly turns into the darkness of night.
quests.funFact: The time just after sunset when the sky is still faintly glowing is called twilight.

quests.instruction: A teacher hands out morning work as the school day begins. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: The school day is just beginning.
quests.explanation: School usually starts in the morning, when the day is fresh, so this is a morning activity.
quests.funFact: Some teachers begin each day with a short warm-up task.

quests.instruction: A family has finished brushing their teeth, reading a story, and tucking in. What is ending?
quests.hint: They are heading toward sleep.
quests.explanation: When we finish our bedtime routine and go to sleep, the day is over and the night is beginning.
quests.funFact: Your body keeps running its clock while you sleep, so it knows when morning comes.

quests.instruction: Two toothbrushing times: which one belongs to the morning?
quests.correctAnswer: Brushing your teeth after waking up
options: Brushing your teeth after waking up
quests.hint: Check what happens right before and right after each action.
quests.explanation: Brushing your teeth after waking up is a morning routine. Brushing before sleep is a night routine.
quests.funFact: Dentists often suggest brushing teeth twice a day, once in the morning and once before bed.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day is usually the longest time for sleeping?
quests.hint: Decide when most people rest for many hours in a row.
quests.explanation: Most people sleep for many hours at night, so night is the part of the day set aside for a long sleep.
quests.funFact: Babies often sleep much more than adults, both at night and during the day.

quests.instruction: After afternoon comes...
quests.hint: Follow the order of the day.
quests.explanation: The parts of the day go in order: morning, afternoon, evening, night. After afternoon, evening begins.
quests.funFact: The order of morning, afternoon, evening, and night repeats every single day.

quests.instruction: Mika sees the Moon from his window before school, but the Sun is not up yet. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Where is the Sun, and what is he about to do?
quests.explanation: A child leaving for school means it is morning, even if the sky is still dark and the Moon can still be seen.
quests.funFact: The Moon can sometimes still be seen in the early morning before the Sun fully rises.

quests.instruction: Which of these is NOT a time when the Sun is usually up?
quests.hint: Pick the time when we usually see stars.
quests.explanation: The Sun is up during the morning, afternoon, and early evening. At night, our part of Earth is turned away from it.
quests.funFact: Not every place has the same daylight hours, but most places have a dark night each day.
